title: Ek number, chaar group!
format: Kitty Gang reaction chain on the Chai Pe Charcha game: one call, and a live counter as the four prize groups go one face at a time

experiment.hook: Ruhi and Megha leaning in over chai on the Chai Pe Charcha home art, heartbeat at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above, chip 'EK NUMBER, CHAAR GROUP? 0/4' pinned from the first frame, Ruhi says 'Sab ek hi number pe atke!'
experiment.variable: a progress counter on the reaction chain: the 11-07 reaction chain (best middle so far, 18% watched) re-run with a 'GROUP x/4' chip that ticks up on every face (Samosa, Rusk, Parle-G, Cutting Chai), so the viewer always sees how many faces are left before the payoff
experiment.hypothesis: fast single faces plus a visible countdown to the end fixes both halves: the counter keeps the hook (checklist 57.1%) and the face cuts keep the middle: skip under 58%, watched % above 22 (best 22), at least 1 save or share on a plain Wednesday chai day

idea: At the Chai Pe Charcha game the whole gang is stuck on one number; 27 is called and each friend grabs a different group: Megha takes Samosa without counting calories, Shruti loves her cheap Rusk, Myra asks if Parle-G goes in the chai, Ishita claims Cutting Chai early, and Aditi, sipping, has actually won it.
beats: hook: sab ek number pe atke, 0/4 / call: 27 / 1/4: Megha Samosa / 2/4: Shruti Rusk / 3/4: Myra Parle-G / 4/4?: Ishita claims Cutting Chai / turn and button: Aditi sips, Cutting Chai uski
caption: Ek number, chaar group! Aap kaun ho: Samosa wali, Rusk wali, Parle-G wali ya chupchaap Cutting Chai wali? Chai wali saheli ko tag karo. Aaj ki {theme} Housie mein kaunsa group aapka?

lines.text: Sab ek hi number pe atke!
lines.say: सब एक ही नंबर पे अटके!

lines.text: Parle-G jeeta! Ab chai mein dubaaun?
lines.say: पारले जी जीता! अब चाय में डुबाऊं?

lines.text: Hmm. Chai bhi meri, Cutting bhi.
lines.say: हम्म। चाय भी मेरी, कटिंग भी।
